title: Touchpoint: career trajectory & next quarter plan (prep for Archit Sinha)
body:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Archit (IC, platform infra) — goal: align on career path, next-quarter scope, and unblock PR that’s blocking a client rollout.
- Archit floated interest in stepping toward tech lead responsibilities; wants to own a small cross-team spike on KV cache improvements.

What I want to get out of this meeting:
- Clear signal on whether Archit wants manager support for a TL path (mentorship, advocacy, scoped leadership).
- Prioritized list of deliverables for next 6 weeks with measurable success criteria.
- Identify immediate blockers (PR review bottleneck, infra test flakiness) and owners.
- Agree on 2 concrete development opportunities (mentoring, design ownership).

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick personal check-in (3 min): energy, time off, any hot items.
2) Wins & progress (5 min): ask Archit to call out 1-2 wins since last 1:1 — shipping GH-PR-4721, reduced p99 tail on local tests.
3) Blockers deep-dive (7 min):
   - GH-PR-4721 blocked by infra-tests flakiness (CI failures on nightly runner).
   - JIRA-INF-1203 flaky e2e in dedicated staging.
   - Who is currently assigned? (note: Priya helped triage yesterday).
4) Career conversation (10 min):
   - Archit interest: move toward tech lead / architect track vs senior IC? Clarify motivation.
   - Discuss short experiment: lead KV-cache spike (4 week boxed scope). Success criteria: design doc + prototype + perf baseline delta >= 15% on throughput or 10% token-cost improvement.
   - Mentorship: propose 1:monthly design review with me + quarterly shadowing of roadmap-planning session.
5) Next steps & action items (5 min): confirm commitments and timelines.

Notes to self / prompts to use:
- Ask: "What part of leading a project excites you most — specs and design, driving delivery, or coordinating partners?"
- If Archit is hesitant with managerial advocacy, offer a 3-month trial "lead" with deliverables and a retro.
- Remind to raise PR review priority with infra on the weekly triage if tests fail again.
- Consider proposing a dedicated CI runner for Archit’s feature branch to reduce noise.

Potential pushbacks and how to respond:
- "I don’t have time for leadership duties": suggest reducing immediate feature commitments by 10% for the 4-week spike and get agreement from product to shift scope.
- "I’m not ready for people management": normalize — emphasize tech lead as IC-first leadership, not direct reports.

Development suggestions (concrete)
- Short-term (4 weeks): lead KV-cache spike; write a 1-pager design + RFC in GH; pair with Priya for infra gating.
- Mid-term (3 months): co-own a roadmap slice (dedicated autoscaler changes) and present outcomes at eng show-and-tell.
- Training resources: link to "Advanced Transformer Optimization" internal course; recommend 1 workshop on cross-team influence skills.

Action items (assigned):
- Archit: Draft 1-pager RFC for KV-cache spike by 2026-08-29 (owner: Archit).
- Noelle: Slack infra on CI flakiness and request temporary dedicated runner; escalate if no response by 2026-08-26 (owner: Noelle).
- Priya: Help repro flaky e2e and drop notes in JIRA-INF-1203 by 2026-08-24 (owner: Priya Rao).
- Archit + Noelle: Schedule 4-week check-in on 2026-09-22 to review spike outcomes.

Follow-up notes to leave after meeting (fill live):
- Capture Archit’s preferred career path wording (TL vs Senior IC).
- Note any re-prioritization requests that require product sign-off.
- Confirm whether Archit wants advocacy for interview loop / promotion packet later this year.

Tone and behavioral cues to watch for:
- Hesitation when talking about leadership -> may need incremental steps.
- Focus on implementation details -> good sign for ownership in infra projects.

Misc quick refs to paste in chat during meeting:
- GH-PR-4721: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4721
- JIRA-INF-1203: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1203
- Confluence draft for CV-scaled caching: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/KV+Cache+Spike

End note (for my follow-up):
- If spike goes well, propose a 0.25 FTE allocation for Archit next quarter to continue leadership work; prepare a short note for Eng leads sync.

Quick checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Re-open GH-PR-4721 CI logs and paste latest failure in thread.
- [ ] Pull up Archit’s last performance checkpoint doc.
- [ ] Draft supportive language for promotion advocacy if they choose TL track.
